independent_unit: fixed circuit instance, resampled within each n cell

fit_diagnostics.loglog: OLS of log(mean orientation_growth_ratio) on log(n); bootstrap resamples circuits independently within each n cell
fit_diagnostics.plateau: OLS of mean orientation_growth_ratio on [1, 1/n]; intercept is an exploratory finite-size diagnostic, not a proof of a nonzero limit

classification: descriptive screen only; g_last>1 identifies a deviation larger than one Haar population-null scale after normalization, otherwise the frozen rho equivalence band [0.90,1.10] is used
